title: NCL Mining Sirdar T&S Gr. C — Mock 05
pattern: NCL Mining Sirdar CBT (100 Q · 100 marks · 90 min · no -ve)

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Competent Person for rescue holds
questions.solution: Rescue Training Certificate.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A dozer push in opencast mining is used for
options: Raising water from the pit sump
Short-distance material movement and dozing on dumps
questions.solution: Dozer push is efficient for short-distance material movement and dump management.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Safety benchmarking compares
questions.solution: Against industry standards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: AMD prevention includes
options: Adding more sulphur to the strata
Clay caps, water covers, alkaline amendments
questions.solution: Clay caps, covers, amendments.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Scaling' refers to
options: Removal of loose or dangerous roof and side material
questions.solution: Scaling is the removal of loose or dangerous material from roof and sides.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'hole stemming plug' in blasting serves to
options: Confine explosive gases and improve energy utilization
questions.solution: Stemming plugs confine gases for better energy utilization.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Vegetation monitoring includes
options: Estimating the tree height by eye
questions.solution: Survival, growth, composition.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under Mines Rules 1955, 'Timbering' in underground mines must be
options: Carried out as per approved support plan
questions.solution: Timbering must follow approved support plans for ground control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Erosion control includes
questions.solution: Mulching, terracing, cover crops.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A filter type self-rescuer provides escape protection against
questions.solution: A filter self-rescuer (e.g. W65) converts toxic carbon monoxide to carbon dioxide using Hopcalite catalyst; it does not supply oxygen.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Examiner' under Mines Rules 1955 for daily inspection must
options: Be a competent person appointed by the mine owner
questions.solution: Examiners must be competent persons appointed by the mine owner.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Surface miner' in opencast mining operates by
options: Mechanically cutting thin seams without blasting
questions.solution: Mechanically cuts thin seams without blasting.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Selective mining' extracts
options: All the material in one pass
questions.solution: Coal of different qualities separately.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Canteen' requirements in mines under Mines Rules 1955 apply when
questions.solution: Canteen requirements apply to mines with more than 250 workers.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Inter-ramp angle is between
options: Crest of one bench and toe of next
questions.solution: Crest and toe of adjacent benches.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Geotechnical Investigation' under CMR 2017 is required for
options: Both underground and open cast mines for stability assessment
During the monsoon season and after heavy rains
For pit dewatering and water control works
After a slope failure or disaster occurs
questions.solution: Geotechnical investigations are required for both types of mines to assess stability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'geological mapping' during mining helps in
options: Understanding rock conditions for safe and efficient extraction
Preparing the wage sheets of the workers
Fixing the service schedules of machinery
Arranging the shift rosters of the blasting crews
questions.solution: Geological mapping guides safe and efficient extraction by understanding rock conditions.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Section 41A of the Mines Act 1952 provides for
questions.solution: Section 41A provides for constitution of Safety Committees in mines.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'objectivity' in technical reporting means
options: Writing in a vague and unclear way
Presenting facts without bias or personal opinion
questions.solution: Objectivity requires presenting facts without personal bias or opinion.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'powder factor' in blasting is expressed as
options: Kilograms of explosive per cubic meter or tonne of rock
questions.solution: Powder factor is the ratio of explosive quantity to rock volume or weight broken.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Annual medical exam under Rules is for
questions.solution: Workers exposed to hazards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'effective bench height' depends on
options: The wind speed prevailing in the working area
The season of the year at the mine site
The number of workers deployed at the face
Boom length, bucket size, material characteristics
questions.solution: Boom, bucket, material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, a shot-firer shall not be employed:
options: On any work which makes his earnings depend on the amount of coal produced
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 190: a shot-firer shall not be employed on work dependent on the quantity of coal/mineral produced, to avoid haste.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Emergency response drills should be conducted
options: Only during the visit of an Inspector
questions.solution: At least every 6 months.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Stop' buttons on heavy equipment in opencast mines must be
options: Accessible from both inside and outside the cab
Operable only by the maintenance crew
questions.solution: Emergency stop buttons must be accessible from both inside and outside the cab.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The least count of a conventional mine surveyor's theodolite is
questions.solution: The standard 20-second vernier theodolite is used for measuring horizontal and vertical angles in mine surveying.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Environmental Compliance Report includes
options: The canteen expenses of the mine for the period
Air, water, noise, dust vs regulatory standards
The office rent payments made by the mine
The staff salary details for the reporting period
questions.solution: All parameters vs standards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Minimum berm width on embankment is

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Blasting Report includes
options: Licence renewal dates of the magazine
Rainfall records of the blast area
questions.solution: Weights, timing, fragmentation, misfires.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Confined space entry requires
options: Permit, gas testing, ventilation, rescue standby
Prior approval of the nearest hospital
A spare set of personal protective equipment
Verbal clearance from the security guard
questions.solution: Permit, gas testing, ventilation, rescue.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A statutory notice from the Chief Inspector must be acknowledged by
options: The Mine Manager, with documented actions to comply
Any worker present at the mine
questions.solution: Statutory notices must be acknowledged by the Mine Manager with documented actions for compliance.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Hydroseeding mixture typically contains
options: Seed, mulch, fertilizer, binding agent, and water
Clean water for the spray application
Sand and gravel for the slopes
Cement for the retaining walls and drains
questions.solution: Hydroseeding mixes seed, mulch, fertilizer, binder, and water for efficient revegetation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, the air at every place in a mine where persons are required to work or pass shall contain not less than ___ oxygen and not more than ___ carbon dioxide
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 153(2)(b): not less than 19 per cent oxygen and not more than 0.5 per cent carbon dioxide.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, 'Roof' in relation to an underground mine means
options: The upper boundary of an underground working
questions.solution: Roof means the upper boundary of an underground working in the context of mining.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Electronic detonators offer
questions.solution: Millisecond-precise delay timing.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Emergency Communication System' in mines under CMR 2017 must
options: Be installed and maintained for communication during emergencies
questions.solution: Emergency communication systems must be installed and maintained for emergency use.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Haul road camber is typically
questions.solution: Typically 2.5-4% for drainage.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under CMR 2017, 'Training' requirements include
options: Induction, on-the-job, and refresher training for all workers
On the day of joining the mine and not again
For supervisory officers of the mine
questions.solution: Training must include induction, on-the-job, and refresher programs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Rehandle' is
questions.solution: Re-handling dumped material.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: End use planning considers
options: The size of the mine lease area
The current market price of coal
questions.solution: Demand, capability, sustainability.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Daily Report includes
options: The personal matters of the staff
The day's weather conditions in the area
questions.solution: Production, safety, equipment, incidents.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: During cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) of an adult, the recommended ratio of chest compressions to rescue breaths is
questions.solution: Standard adult CPR uses a compression-to-ventilation ratio of 30:2.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Dust suppression on haul roads includes
options: Increasing the speed of dumpers on the road
Removing the top layer of the road surface
Paving the road with asphalt only
questions.solution: Water, chemicals, vegetation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The SMP must be prepared by the
options: Mine Manager or an authorized person
questions.solution: The SMP must be prepared by the Mine Manager or an authorized person as per CMR 2017.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Operator visibility from heavy equipment in opencast mines is improved by
options: Using cameras, mirrors, and proximity detection systems
questions.solution: Cameras, mirrors, and proximity systems improve operator visibility in large equipment.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Haul road berm height should be at least
questions.solution: At least half (50%) the diameter of the largest tyre of the vehicles using the road.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Pit toe' is the
options: Bottom edge where face meets floor
questions.solution: Bottom edge where face meets floor.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Stockpile Inventory Report includes
options: Number of workers at the stock yard
Daily weather forecast for the mine area
questions.solution: Volume, grade, moisture, rehandling.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Welfare Officer required in mines with
questions.solution: Mines Rules 1955 Rule 72(1): a Welfare Officer is required where 500 or more persons are ordinarily employed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Permit-to-Work systems in mining are used for
options: High-risk activities like hot work, confined space entry, and electrical work
Daily attendance marking of the workers
questions.solution: PTW systems control high-risk activities by ensuring hazards are identified and controlled before work.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Annual Health Report' of mine workers under CMR 2017 must be
options: Made available to the workers concerned
questions.solution: Health reports must be made available to the workers concerned.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Blackdamp' found in underground workings consists mainly of
questions.solution: Blackdamp is a suffocating mixture of carbon dioxide and nitrogen, formed where oxygen has been consumed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Water gel explosives are
questions.solution: Slurry explosives.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'safety risk assessment matrix' helps to
options: Prioritize risks based on likelihood and consequence
Eliminate the need for safety training in the mine
Guarantee that no accident will occur in the mine
Fix the production target of the working face
questions.solution: Risk matrices prioritize risks based on likelihood and severity for focused control.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Stop Work Order' under the Mines Act can be issued when
options: There is imminent danger to life or health of workers
questions.solution: Stop Work Orders are issued when there is imminent danger to workers' life or health.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'contractor safety management system' ensures
options: Contractors follow the same safety standards as the mine
Contractors are exempt from all statutory safety rules
Contractors arrange their own rescue and medical facilities
Contractors are paid only after completion of work
questions.solution: Contractor safety systems ensure compliance with mine safety standards.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Accident Report must contain
options: Only the estimated cost of the accident
The insurance details of the equipment
questions.solution: Comprehensive details.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Refresher training under CMR is required
questions.solution: Periodically as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Management Review' in mines should be conducted
options: At least annually by senior management
Only when a serious accident occurs
At the discretion of the workers' union
Once during the career of a manager
questions.solution: Management reviews must be conducted at least annually.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In the event of a misfire, a relieving hole shall be drilled at a distance of not less than
questions.solution: CMR 2017 Reg 204(6): the relieving hole shall be drilled so that at no point it is nearer than 30 cm from the misfired hole.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: NONEL systems use
questions.solution: Shock tubes for detonation signal.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Under the Mines Act 1952, the District Magistrate may
options: Exercise the powers and perform the duties of an Inspector
Approve the production plan of the mine
Fix the wages of the mine workers
questions.solution: Mines Act 1952 S.5(3): the District Magistrate may exercise the powers and perform the duties of an Inspector, subject to general or special orders of the Central Government.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'Safety Equipment Calibration' in mines must be
options: Regular and documented per manufacturer specifications
questions.solution: Equipment calibration must be regular and documented.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: A 'production blast' in opencast mining is designed to
questions.solution: Production blasts maximize rock breakage for efficient excavation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Smooth blasting' creates
questions.solution: A clean, smooth final wall.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: In bord and pillar workings, the main purpose of testing (sounding) the roof is to
options: Detect loose or unsafe roof before persons work beneath it
Measure the temperature of the roof strata
Estimate the grade of coal in the roof
Determine the exact height of the gallery
questions.solution: Roof testing detects loose or detached roof so that unsafe rock can be supported or brought down before work proceeds.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: The 'land use compatibility' in reclamation means
options: Ensuring post-mining land use is compatible with surrounding area
questions.solution: Land use must be compatible with the surrounding area and community needs.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Underground lighting must be
questions.solution: Adequate as prescribed.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: Acid-forming materials in overburden should be
options: Isolated and buried to prevent acid generation
questions.solution: Acid-forming materials must be isolated and buried to prevent AMD generation.

questions.subject: Technical (Mining)
questions.stem: 'Mine development' includes
options: Establishing haul roads, dumps, and infrastructure
Computing the monthly coal sale proceeds
Preparing the payroll of the staff
questions.solution: Establishes haul roads, dumps, infrastructure.
